One day-
lines.zh: 有一天 ——

lines.en: Everyone you love is going to die.
lines.zh: 你爱着的每一个人都将死去。

lines.en: But that’s okay.
lines.zh: 但那没关系。

lines.en: Because, one day-
lines.zh: 因为，有一天 ——

lines.en: You are going to die as well.
lines.zh: 你也会死去。

lines.en: And so will I.
lines.zh: 我也是。

lines.en: All of us are going to die.
lines.zh: 我们所有人都将死去。

lines.en: But for now-
lines.zh: 但在那之前 ——

lines.en: Please live a beautiful life.
lines.zh: 请过一种美丽的人生。

lines.en: I love you.
lines.zh: 我爱你。

lines.en: scene sky_splash
scene sky_76
$ renpy.pause(4, hard=True)
scene black
scene bedroom_day
I wake up again. A wonderful start to the day.
lines.zh: 我又一次醒来。这一天开始了，真是美妙。

lines.en: Hello, world.
lines.zh: 你好，世界。

lines.en: My mouth is dry.
lines.zh: 我的嘴很干。

lines.en: I grab a half-emptied water bottle from the nightstand and pour its contents down my throat.
lines.zh: 我从床头柜上抓起一瓶喝剩一半的水，然后把里面的东西灌进喉咙。

lines.en: Millions of bacterial organisms that snuck into the bottle overnight are consumed in the process.
lines.zh: 上百万个趁夜里溜进瓶子里的细菌，就这样被我一起吞了下去。

lines.en: Goodbye, new friends.
lines.zh: 再见了，新朋友们。

lines.en: Please enjoy the warm embrace of my intestines.
lines.zh: 请好好享受我肠道的温暖拥抱吧。

lines.en: I think to myself for a moment-
lines.zh: 我思考了片刻 ——

lines.en: When was the last time I thanked my organs for performing their daily tasks?
lines.zh: 上一次我感谢自己的器官维持日常运转，是什么时候来着？

lines.en: : Thank you, organs.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你们，器官们。

lines.en: : Please continue to regulate the functions of my body.
lines.zh: : 请继续调节我身体的各项机能。

lines.en: : Your hard work is greatly appreciated.
lines.zh: : 你们的辛勤劳动，我感激不尽。

lines.en: No reply. As expected.
lines.zh: 没有回应。意料之中。

lines.en: Organs don’t talk.
lines.zh: 器官不会说话。

lines.en: I think it’s good to thank them anyway, though.
lines.zh: 不过我觉得，道谢本身就是件好事。

lines.en: Who knows when they might decide to turn on me?
lines.zh: 谁知道它们什么时候会决定反咬我一口呢？

lines.en: Oh, right. I should introduce myself.
lines.zh: 哦，对了。我该自我介绍一下。

lines.en: My name is Yuu.
lines.zh: 我叫 Yuu。

lines.en: I’m the protagonist of this game.
lines.zh: 我是这款游戏的主角。

lines.en: Welcome to my room!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到我的房间！

lines.en: I haven’t changed it in many years.
lines.zh: 我已经很多年没改动过它了。

lines.en: Every once in a while, though, someone will come over and I’ll have to tidy things up.
lines.zh: 不过偶尔还是会有人过来，那我就得收拾一下。

lines.en: That happened yesterday.
lines.zh: 昨天就发生过一次。

lines.en: So consider yourself lucky that you don't have to see it at its worst!
lines.zh: 所以你该庆幸，自己不用看到它最糟糕的样子！

lines.en: Who came over?
lines.zh: 谁来过了？

lines.en: Ahh, my childhood friend.
lines.zh: 啊，是我的青梅竹马。

lines.en: Her name is Saki.
lines.zh: 她叫 Saki。

lines.en: She used to live next door.
lines.zh: 她以前住在隔壁。

lines.en: Two years ago, she came home from school and found out that her entire family had been butchered by one of the neighbors.
lines.zh: 两年前，她放学回家，发现全家都被一个邻居屠杀了。

lines.en: I could hear her screams from all the way over here.
lines.zh: 她的尖叫声，我在这边都听得一清二楚。

lines.en: I think they sounded something like this:
lines.zh: 我觉得听起来大概是这样：

lines.en: $ renpy.music.set_volume(0.1, 0.0, channel="music")
$ renpy.pause(3.8, hard=True)
$ renpy.music.set_volume(1.0, 0.3, channel="music")
She has been very sad ever since.
lines.zh: 从那以后，她一直都很伤心。

lines.en: But now she comes to wake me up in the morning, so not everyone lost something that day.
lines.zh: 不过现在她早上会来叫我起床，所以那天也不是每个人都失去了什么。

lines.en: Saki moved into an apartment several blocks away, but she needs to pass my house to get to school.
lines.zh: Saki 搬到了几个街区外的一间公寓，但她上学得经过我家。

lines.en: I think that’s probably why she stops here as much as she does.
lines.zh: 我想，这大概就是她这么常在这里停留的原因。

lines.en: It’s not because she wants to see me.
lines.zh: 不是因为她想见我。

lines.en: She just feels bad.
lines.zh: 她只是觉得过意不去。

lines.en: Oh, right. I haven’t told you yet.
lines.zh: 哦，对了。我还没跟你说过。

lines.en: I’m sick.
lines.zh: 我有病。

lines.en: It’s not life-threatening or anything like that.
lines.zh: 不是什么会危及性命的病。

lines.en: It has something to do with how my brain is wired.
lines.zh: 跟我大脑的构造方式有关。

lines.en: I think God may have mixed up the cables when he was creating me.
lines.zh: 我觉得，上帝在造我的时候大概把线接错了。

lines.en: Or maybe one of his interns was responsible or something.
lines.zh: 也可能是由他手下的某个实习生负责的。

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: God isn’t real.
lines.zh: 上帝并不存在。

lines.en: Nothing is real.
lines.zh: 什么都不存在。

lines.en: Actually, interns are real.
lines.zh: 不过，实习生是存在的。

lines.en: But anyway, I’m fine now.
lines.zh: 总之，我现在很好。

lines.en: Things are good!
lines.zh: 一切都好！

lines.en: Life is beautiful.
lines.zh: 人生是美丽的。

lines.en: Amen.
lines.zh: 阿门。

lines.en: : Yuu! You’re going to be late for school!
lines.zh: : Yuu！你上学要迟到了！

lines.en: ...Is what my mom would probably be saying right now if she could.
lines.zh: ……如果我妈妈还在世，她现在大概会这么说。

lines.en: She was killed by aliens a few years ago.
lines.zh: 几年前她被外星人杀死了。

lines.en: It was a horrifying sight to behold.
lines.zh: 那景象惨不忍睹。

lines.en: Hahah, just kidding.
lines.zh: 哈哈，开玩笑的。

lines.en: She died of cancer.
lines.zh: 她死于癌症。

lines.en: I like to say aliens were the cause because it makes her passing easier to deal with.
lines.zh: 我喜欢说死因是外星人，因为那样她的离世会更好接受一些。

lines.en: Rewriting the past is fun.
lines.zh: 改写过去很有趣。

lines.en: It's also a fantastic coping mechanism.
lines.zh: 它也是一种绝佳的应对机制。

lines.en: I highly recommend it if you ever get the chance.
lines.zh: 若有机会，我强烈推荐你试试。

lines.en: Let's hope things don't come to that, though.
lines.zh: 不过还是希望事情别走到那一步。

lines.en: Reality is scary.
lines.zh: 现实很可怕。

lines.en: Cancer is scary.
lines.zh: 癌症很可怕。

lines.en: And that is why we thank our organs!
lines.zh: 所以我们才要感谢自己的器官！

lines.en: : Thank you, organs.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你们，器官们。

lines.en: No response again.
lines.zh: 又没有得到回应。

lines.en: Maybe one day.
lines.zh: 也许有一天吧。

lines.en: I bring myself to the closet and dig out a fresh school uniform amidst the piles of unhung and unwashed clothes.
lines.zh: 我走到衣柜前，翻出一套干净的学生制服。

lines.en: I’m going to have to do laundry soon.
lines.zh: 我得尽快洗衣服了。

lines.en: Doing laundry is always a hassle because the water was turned off several months ago.
lines.zh: 洗衣服总是很麻烦，因为几个月前就停水了。

lines.en: Now, I have to manually gather it from the lake nearby.
lines.zh: 现在我只能手动去附近的湖里打水。

lines.en: Who has the energy to do that?
lines.zh: 谁有那个精力干这种事？

lines.en: Water is surprisingly heavy for a compound with only three parts. But I guess anything is heavy if you have enough of it.
lines.zh: 对一个只由三个原子构成的化合物来说，水意外地沉。

lines.en: Except for air. Or any other gas.
lines.zh: 空气除外。或者任何一种气体。

lines.en: You get the point, right?
lines.zh: 你懂我意思吧？

lines.en: Occasionally, Saki will stop by and take some of my clothes to wash at her apartment.
lines.zh: 偶尔 Saki 会顺路过来，把我的一些衣服拿回她公寓去洗。

lines.en: They have a laundromat in one of the buildings.
lines.zh: 其中一栋楼里有家自助洗衣店。

lines.en: The heat from the machines and lack of ventilation in there makes it feel more like walking into a run-down sauna, though.
lines.zh: 机器散出的热气，加上那里通风不良，让人感觉更像是走进了一间破旧的桑拿房。

lines.en: I don’t really like going inside for that reason alone.
lines.zh: 光凭这一点，我就不太想进去。

lines.en: But Saki doesn’t mind. I think it helps her take her mind off of things.
lines.zh: 但 Saki 不介意。我觉得那能让她暂时不去想那些事。

lines.en: : Yuu! Hurry up! What are you doing in there?!
lines.zh: : Yuu！快点！你在里面干什么？！

lines.en: : Just a minute! I’m getting dressed!
lines.zh: : 等一下！我在换衣服！

lines.en: Jesus Christ, would it kill her to be a little more patient?
lines.zh: 天哪，她就不能稍微有点耐心吗？

lines.en: Answer = No.
lines.zh: 答案 = 不能。

lines.en: She can not die twice.
lines.zh: 她不可能死两次。

lines.en: It would be rather unfortunate if she could.
lines.zh: 要是真能的话，那可就太不幸了。

lines.en: I finish putting on my uniform and head for the door.
lines.zh: 我穿好制服，走向门口。

lines.en: There is a small pile of candy on the shelf next to it.
lines.zh: 门边的架子上放着一小堆糖果。

lines.en: I get cranky if I don’t eat in the morning, so I take two pieces and shove them into my mouth.
lines.zh: 我早上不吃东西就会烦躁，所以拿了两颗。

lines.en: A delicious breakfast.
lines.zh: 一份美味的早餐。

lines.en: Any more than two would be dangerous to my health.
lines.zh: 再多就会危及我的健康了。

lines.en: : Goodbye, house. Take care of yourself while I am away.
lines.zh: : 再见了，房子。我不在的时候好好保重。

lines.en: The house does not respond.
lines.zh: 房子没有回应。

lines.en: I open the door.
lines.zh: 我打开门。

lines.en: The building winces in pain as part of its body is suddenly mangled into an uncomfortable position.
lines.zh: 这栋楼痛苦地抽搐了一下，因为它身体的一部分突然被扭成了一个不舒服的姿势。

lines.en: When I close the door, it goes back to normal.
lines.zh: 等我把门关上，它又恢复了原样。

lines.en: The pain goes away.
lines.zh: 疼痛消失了。

lines.en: I'm sorry.
lines.zh: 对不起。

lines.en: scene black
scene street_day
I’ve lived in this town my whole life.
lines.zh: 我这辈子都住在这个镇上。

lines.en: And I will probably continue to live here until the day I die.
lines.zh: 而且我大概会一直住在这里，直到我死的那天。

lines.en: I hate it just as much as any teenager hates their hometown-
lines.zh: 我讨厌它，就跟任何一个讨厌家乡的青少年一样 ——

lines.en: Enough to complain but not enough to go anywhere else.
lines.zh: 嘴上抱怨得够多，却没到真的要去别处的程度。

lines.en: Moving would be too much of a hassle.
lines.zh: 搬家太麻烦了。

lines.en: I’ll probably just get an ordinary job after school and spend the rest of my life selling porno magazines over a corner-store counter or something like that.
lines.zh: 毕业后我大概就找份普通的工作，然后在便利店柜台后面卖黄色杂志度过余生，诸如此类。

lines.en: Just kidding. No one reads porn in magazine-form anymore.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。现在没人看杂志版的色情刊物了。

lines.en: It’s all about Internet porn now.
lines.zh: 如今已经是网络色情的天下。

lines.en: I guess this just means I’m doomed to a life of unemployment.
lines.zh: 看来这就意味着，我注定要过一辈子失业的日子。

lines.en: How unfortunate.
lines.zh: 多么不幸。

lines.en: : Yuu-kun? Is that you?
lines.zh: : Yuu 君？是你吗？

lines.en: : Hm?
I turn around to be greeted by a familiar face.
lines.zh: 我转过身，迎面是一张熟悉的面孔。

lines.en: show reina_normal
: Oh, Reina. Good morning.
lines.zh: : 哦，Reina。早上好。

lines.en: show reina_smile
: Morning! Are you actually coming to school today?
lines.zh: : 早上好！你今天真的要去学校吗？

lines.en: : It certainly appears that way.
lines.zh: : 看起来确实是这样。

lines.en: : I figure it can’t hurt to show up every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，偶尔去露个面也没什么坏处。

lines.en: This is Reina. She’s probably the most ordinary person I know.
lines.zh: 这位是 Reina。她大概是我认识的人里最普通的一个。

lines.en: Her three sizes are 89/61/88 and she loves horror movies.
lines.zh: 她的三围是 89/61/88，而且她喜欢恐怖片。

lines.en: We used to hang out a lot but I distanced myself from her for reasons I don’t really understand.
lines.zh: 我们以前经常见面，但后来我疏远了她，原因我自己也不太明白。

lines.en: show reina_dirty
: Shocker. And here I was thinking you’d dropped out.
lines.zh: : 真让人吃惊。我还以为你已经退学了呢。

lines.en: : Nope. Still a totally normal student.
lines.zh: : 没有。我还是个完全正常的学生。

lines.en: : Mhm. A totally normal student with a totally {i}abnormal{/i} attendance record.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。一个完全正常、却有着完全{i}不正常{/i}的学生。

lines.en: show reina_smile
: But hey, at least we won't have to wake up this early for much longer.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，至少我们以后不用再这么早起床了。

lines.en: : There's not much time left.
lines.zh: : 剩下的时间不多了。

lines.en: : It would be pretty stupid for you to drop out now of all times.
lines.zh: : 你要是偏偏挑这个时候退学，那就太蠢了。

lines.en: Oh, right. There are only two more weeks left until the end of the school year.
lines.zh: 哦，对了。距离毕业只剩两周了。

lines.en: After that, Reina and I will graduate and slowly drift apart from one another.
lines.zh: 在那之后，Reina 和我就会毕业，然后慢慢疏远。

lines.en: That’s just how life works.
lines.zh: 人生就是这么回事。

lines.en: And unless the two of us start dating or harbor a child together, I can’t see that changing.
lines.zh: 除非我们两个开始交往，或者共同怀上一个孩子。

lines.en: : Hey, Yuu-kun. Wanna walk to school together?
lines.zh: : 喂，Yuu 君。要不要一起走去学校？

lines.en: show reina_dirty
: You know, for old time's sake and stuff.
lines.zh: : 你知道的，看在往日情分的份上之类的。

lines.en: : Old time’s sake? Weren’t we on cleaning duty together like sixteen days ago?
lines.zh: : 往日情分？我们不是大概两周前才一起做过值日吗？

lines.en: : That’s basically the fourth strongest bond you can have with someone.
lines.zh: : 那基本上算是你能和别人建立起的第四强的羁绊了。

lines.en: show reina_annoyed
: Uhh, no...It’s not.
lines.zh: : 呃，不……才不是。

lines.en: : And what’s with all these weirdly-specific numbers?
lines.zh: : 还有，这些精确到个位数的怪说法是怎么回事？

lines.en: : You know me. Just trying to keep things exciting.
lines.zh: : 你懂我的。只是想让日子有点意思。

lines.en: show reina_smile
: Yeah, yeah. Whatever.
lines.zh: : 好好好。随便吧。

lines.en: show reina_dirty
: I guess nothing is all that surprising if it's coming from you.
lines.zh: : 我想，只要是出自你口，什么都不会让人意外。

lines.en: Why do I feel like that is an insult?
lines.zh: 为什么我觉得那是在侮辱我？

lines.en: show reina_smile
: So, are we walking together or not?
lines.zh: : 所以，我们到底要不要一起走？

lines.en: What should I do?
lines.zh: 我该怎么办？

lines.en: Walk with Reina
lines.zh: 和 Reina 一起走

lines.en: jump walkreina
Walk alone
lines.zh: 独自走

lines.en: jump walkalone
